title: Uniform mixture of function testers
statement: Let $t>0$, and let $T_i$ for $i\in\{0,\ldots,t-1\}$ be nonadaptive testers with the same domain, codomain, and number of queries. Define a tester by choosing $i$ uniformly, sampling a seed according to $T_i$'s seed law, and then using $T_i$'s queries and acceptance rule.
hypotheses_covered: The number $t$ of testers is positive
All testers have the same domain and codomain
All testers make the same number of queries
